build_catmull_rom_spline: build a Catmull-Rom spline from a list of 3D control points for smooth path generation
compute_gravity_aligned_MOBB: compute a gravity-aligned minimum oriented bounding box from a set of 3D points
get_transformed_bb: get a transformed bounding box by applying a 4x4 transformation matrix to an OBB
create_OBB: create an oriented bounding box to represent the spatial extent of 3D geometry
create_Ray: create a Ray with an origin and direction for 3D intersection testing
